purpose: Current manuscript claim lineage, not a new source-verification or efficacy score.
claim_id_policy: C1-C3 are bounded source-conditioned synthesis cases; F2_STAGE_COST/F3_HOLDOUT are evaluation distinctions; H2/H3 are saved archive results; WF preserves the original negative endpoint.

evidence_status_policy.DIRECT_SUPPORT: The field directly supports the stated narrow object/condition distinction, not an unmeasured broad effect.
evidence_status_policy.CLAIM_LIMIT: The field bounds a particular extension; NR is not positive evidence of defense failure.
evidence_status_policy.BACKGROUND_ONLY: Retained in the 66-position inventory without a dependency on a current named claim.

case_fact_policy: Source result aliases can be subconditions/context; a nonempty related_unit_id is not an assertion of identical experimental configuration.
historical_policy: Old field strings, old claim labels and old source locators are explicitly historical. No old manuscript line numbers are reused as current anchors.
source_correction_policy: Dangol live locator/condition use the primary OHTTP paragraph after Table5 and fresh per-session IDs; historical pooled-ID text is retained only as historical input. source-corrections.json is maintained separately.
limits: Not independent human double coding or external researcher validation.
66 mapped positions are not 66 new verifications.
33 heterogeneous units are not a common denominator for field-wide defense failure/absence.
Removing the four unbound assertions does not alter C1-C3; it does not establish their missing experimental results.
No model, training, network request, fit, rerun, or raw-data change is performed by this builder.

claims.title: Final receiving emitter
claims.bounded_claim: A protection result at an upstream emitter does not by itself certify a downstream content-aware emitter's observation view.
claims.support_and_numerical_anchor: NetEcho's deployment/capture distinctions support checking the actual final stream; the UI archive contrast is not a live placement experiment.
claims.unsupported_extensions: No exact timestamp reconstruction, matched causal NetEcho effect, all-seven-live claim or field-wide theorem; a validated view-preserving/no-extra-target-state bridge can permit transfer.

claims.title: Executed cover and task state
claims.bounded_claim: Transport shaping, transformed captures and executed mobile actions cannot inherit each other's task-safety or cost conclusions without a condition-matched bridge.
claims.support_and_numerical_anchor: Dangol live/capture operating points are separated; the live protocol testbed co-locates client, relay, gateway and agent on one loopback host. AHB task-success subconditions show why executable state-changing cover requires its own task outcome.
claims.unsupported_extensions: History+Long success 0.7143 is a retained contrary subcondition, not noninferiority or successful evasion. RAW0.75 vs combined0.15 is not an isolated causal Fake effect. AHB detector publication-run/D2 bindings remain NR-V.

claims.title: Adaptation condition and mechanism identity
claims.bounded_claim: Protected-data fitting, paired common-test adaptation, fixed common guardrails and costs of different cache/padding mechanisms answer different deployment questions.
claims.support_and_numerical_anchor: UI Traces and SIG common-guardrail contrasts bind different estimands; Early Bird, KVGov and SpliceDefense bind calibration, simulation and component costs separately.
claims.unsupported_extensions: These distinctions are systematized prior findings, not newly discovered attacks. Scientific refitting does not establish the observer's operational labeled-data access or a fair adaptation budget; source code does not authenticate a publication run.

claims.title: Generator holdout
claims.bounded_claim: An unseen task split is not by itself a holdout of the browser, topology, hardware calibration or other generator of the measured signal.
claims.support_and_numerical_anchor: UI/FP-Agent/browser attributes, topology transfer and LeakyLMs' calibrated hardware conditions motivate naming the generator and holdout separately.
claims.unsupported_extensions: No universal failure of task holdout, new cross-generator experiment, task-independent attribution or field-wide ranking is claimed.

claims.title: Fixed archive representation increment
claims.bounded_claim: On the fixed UI archive receiver, adding bigrams to counts/page age improves predictive loss by 0.3447 nats and accuracy from51.29% to66.26%.
claims.support_and_numerical_anchor: 1,135 test records/226 questions; loss interval[0.2974,0.3944]. The matched three-identity ten-question interval crosses zero; all-14 common-question support is empty.
claims.unsupported_extensions: Archive cross-document order is assumed, not authenticated for an ordinary website. No mutual information, task-independent identity, new live attack or direct protection-placement test follows. The 12 existing fits were not rerun in this revision.

claims.title: Bounded offline adaptation reanalysis
claims.bounded_claim: For saved page-local U(0,5000ms) timestamp perturbations preserving types/order, refitting improves paired loss by0.1503 nats on the same perturbed test records.
claims.support_and_numerical_anchor: Three saved realizations; interval[0.1205,0.1815]; descriptive effects are negative for five declared identities. It reanalyzes an already reported adaptation phenomenon.
claims.unsupported_extensions: No executed delay, objective task utility or live cost is measured. No retuning, new fits or model requests occurred in this revision.

claims.title: Retained workflow joint-endpoint negative result
claims.bounded_claim: In the finite model-assisted checklist comparison, tested SCOPE traversal does not improve the original joint endpoint over the complete structured checklist.

claims.unsupported_extensions: Not independent natural-paper reviews or researcher participants; no human-productivity conclusion or universal framework inferiority. Decision-only post-hoc gains do not replace the original endpoint.
